rules: Original benchmark is previously observed data; preserve unchanged
No tuning after opening final results
Same resource ceilings, actual costs reported; no currency conversion
Configured noise truth can be observationally invisible; retain losing cases
Phase strategy is a complementary measurement plus existing ideal-state diagnostic, not tomography
Recovery evaluated separately with full independent validation cost

limitations: Configured noise may be invisible in task measurements; category accuracy is not detection power
Fixed circuits and few seeds; intervals are descriptive, not unseen-algorithm generalization
Phase policy still uses privileged exact ideal simulation for logical/noise attribution
All policies have equal ceilings; actual resources differ; recovery evaluated separately
